description: Asks whether Decimal and Currency payloads survive arithmetic, conversion and comparison. Decimal: the stored M of Vals (the -(2^64+5)/10^4 magnitude) through identity, unary minus, +0, *1, CDec, CDbl, CCur and division forms, and CDec of BSTR forms (locale-sensitive text, recorded as such) for scale-28 values and equal values with different scales. Currency: a declared Currency parameter with 12.3456, the maximum and the minimum, each through identity, plus or minus one unit, and doubling, plus CCur rounding at the fifth decimal and the stored C. Each expression is its own SELECT. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT CDec(-1844674407370955) - CDec(1621) / CDec(10000) FROM One
PARAMETERS pc Currency; SELECT pc AS v FROM One
PARAMETERS pc Currency; SELECT pc + CCur(0.0001) AS v FROM One
PARAMETERS pc Currency; SELECT pc - CCur(0.0001) AS v FROM One
PARAMETERS pc Currency; SELECT pc * 2 AS v FROM One
